in_marathi.name: Mahendrasinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahendrasinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahendra is the name of Lord Shiva, the ruler of mountains. Sinh means lion, indicating power and courage. Thus, Mahendrasinh translates to ‘Lord of the Lion’ or ‘Lord of the Mountains’.

in_bengali.name: Mahendrasinh

in_bengali.long_meaning: Mahendrasinh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mahendra is the name of Lord Shiva, the ruler of mountains. Sinh means lion, indicating power and courage. Thus, Mahendrasinh translates to ‘Lord of the Lion’ or ‘Lord of the Mountains’.
